name: Woody
biography: Woody thinks Linux is a member of the Charlie Brown gang who can lift heavy things but not always spell them. He has had some success with RF exploits in the past with the first ever goTenna exploit talk in the RF wireless village as well as the first attack against Ford Raptor key fobs with RaptorCaptor exploit. Woody’s unique background, familiar to some, gives him a creative aspect to the impact of goTenna Pro research in the physical and RF world. Woody is also a staff member in the RFHacker Sanctuary, a member of Security Tribe, and has appeared on a few episodes of Hak5 describing novel device attacks.
